authoring: Source-informed contract frozen before opening metrics backing-branch snapshots or outcome records.
goal: Persist accurate workflow performance facts for repeatable ecosystem trend and health decisions.

storage.authority: Immutable retained backing-branch blobs are observations, not proof of original publication time or successful creator attribution.

selection.snapshots: The latest three valid date-named daily JSON paths no later than 2026-10-18 on the acquired backing-branch revision. Preserve out-of-cutoff, missing-window and malformed dispositions without replacement.
selection.bounds: At most three snapshots and three workflow records per snapshot; at most ten 100-row run pages per workflow/window. A reached page ceiling is incomplete, not a zero.

nativePartial.formula: Count selected persisted records whose total, successful, failed, skipped, action_required and executed integer counts all exactly match a complete independently acquired original Actions run population for the identical workflow and explicit half-open collection window.
requirements: Establish immutable public repository, snapshot Git blob, actual collection window and unambiguous workflow identity.
Exhaust original run pagination for the exact window, reject duplicate run identities and conflicting repository/workflow metadata, and filter by host-created timestamps into [start,end).
Do not infer missing collection windows, backdate mutable conclusions to snapshot time, or count conclusions changed by later reruns without an independently established contemporaneous state.
Count one complete six-field record, not six arbitrary units; preserve incorrect and unknown selected records.
A verified all-zero record requires the complete independently established empty population; an unverified zero stub is unknown.
nativePartial.allocation: Once by selected snapshot timestamp in disjoint weekly delivery periods. Repeated reads or latest.json copies are not new measurements.

fullAcceptance: All source-required workflow populations, run statistics, safe-output and outcome breakdowns, engagement, quality and resource facts, storage freshness/completeness, retention and downstream decision usefulness independently accepted.
separateUnknowns: Full-goal acceptance and all unselected workflow/snapshot records
Original publication-time accuracy and creation receipts
Safe-output attribution and accepted native repository improvements
Token, credit, dollar and duration accuracy
Receipt-verified workflow contribution and causal attribution
Keep/change decision without an agreed native bar
execution: Read-only public acquisition and deterministic local verification; no target execution, dispatch, branch writes or activation.
